content_scope: abstracts_only; no full-text article sections; all normalized nonwhitespace text covered by chunks

similarity.similarity_method: L2-normalize existing 1024d Qwen3 chunk vectors, equal-weight mean per frozen revision, L2-normalize mean, cosine; percentile linear interpolation (n-1)*p

pooling_sensitivity.limitation: Equal-chunk pooling can over-weight short residual chunks; alternative is a sensitivity check, not an independent human similarity gold.

corpus_composition.partition_method: inductive single-rater analyst reading; not an objective unique ontology or independent human gold

manual_pair_audit.mapping_limitation: Selected label correspondences are supplemental and rubric-dependent; not extractor recall or causal contribution percentages. Source claims may differ in polarity, analyte or conditions.

read_only_validation.neo4j509nodes417edges: MATCH/RETURN through execute_read; fact IDs and endpoints matched PostgreSQL
read_only_validation.qdrant: GET metadata and POST points/scroll only,136 existing vectors matched all chunk IDs

diagnosis: CASE E: ontology/representation plus selective extraction, secondary lexical canonicalization, real periphery and claim-specific differences; corpus-limited-only rejected for thematic connectivity, not for strict detailed claim equality

publication_policy.published: authored audit reports, derived analysis tables, integrity hashes and analysis scripts; raw corpus/vector/database exports excluded
